note: An MCP endpoint that always answers 500 was configured with maxAttempts 3 and a 200ms->800ms backoff. The client made 4 attempts and then stopped: the entry never activated, no MCP tool reached the model, and no warning was printed.
backoffPattern: nominal 200ms -> 400ms -> 800ms; measured gaps 235/406/812ms, i.e. roughly but not exactly doubling (x1.73, x2.00), with tens of ms of overhead

contrast.thisRecord: budget exhaustion is silent: exit 0, no warning

caveat: attemptCount 4 with maxAttempts 3 means the initial attempt plus 3 retries. This record measures one configuration; other values were not swept.

delaysAreNominalVsMeasured.note: measured 812ms exceeds maxDelayMs 800ms, so clamping is not demonstrated here
